text: At least one Federal Reserve target-range rate cut between February 26 and December 31, 2026?
yes: If the Federal Reserve cuts its target federal funds rate range at least once between February 26, 2026 and December 31, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes. The window begins February 26, 2026. A qualifying FOMC announcement of a lower target federal funds rate range counts; changes to unrelated administered rates do not. Check already elapsed portions of the window as well as remaining meetings.
no: No event satisfying the YES contract within its specified window.
void: Record void/disputed if Kalshi cancels, returns a nonbinary settlement, or rule interpretation prevents matching the frozen contract. Preserve history.
resolution_source: Kalshi final settlement for KXRATECUT-26DEC31 using frozen contract terms and designated underlying sources; preserve later rule changes separately.
